document_api_meta.title: Query Creator Promotion Details in Target Collaboration
document_api_meta.env_desc: Query the creator commission rate, number of promotional video contents and number of live‑stream promotions for specified creator, specified invitation and specified product.

request_header_param.name: x-tts-access-token
request_header_param.desc: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

request_query_param.name: app_key
request_query_param.desc: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

request_query_param.name: sign
request_query_param.desc: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

request_query_param.name: timestamp
request_query_param.desc: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

request_query_param.name: shop_cipher
request_query_param.desc:
Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response. 
Get by API [Get Authorization Shop](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9?external_id=6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9)

request_body_param.name: query
request_body_param.desc: Product ID or product title to match, as selected by `query_type`. Provide both fields to filter the returned products.

request_body_param.name: query_type
request_body_param.desc:
Specifies how `query` filters products. Possible values:
- `PRODUCT_ID`: Match the product ID exactly.
- `PRODUCT_NAME`: Match product titles by case-sensitive substring.

request_body_param.name: ^added_types
request_body_param.desc:
Product added type list, support status: 
-ALL: all status
-ADDED: creator added product
NOT_ADDED: creator not added product

response_param.name: code
response_param.desc: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

response_param.name: message
response_param.desc: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.

response_param.name: ^data
response_param.desc: Promotion details for products in the target collaboration invitation group.

response_param.name: ^^^^target_commission
response_param.desc: Product target collaboration commission. e.g. 2200 mean 22% commission rate

response_param.name: ^^^^open_commission
response_param.desc: Product open collaboration commission. e.g. 2200 mean 22% commission rate

response_param.name: ^^^^old_target_ads_commission
response_param.desc: Product old target ads collaboration commission

response_param.name: ^^^^commission_effective_time
response_param.desc: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the target collaboration commission becomes effective.

response_param.name: ^^^^ads_commission_effective_time
response_param.desc: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the target collaboration Ads commission becomes effective.

response_param.name: ^^^^product_status
response_param.desc:
Product status  
1: Active
2; Sold out
3: product deactivated by seller; 
4: product deactivated by platform
5: product reject
6: product deleted

response_param.name: ^^^video_count
response_param.desc: Creator post video count in collaboration

response_param.name: ^^^is_commission_effective
response_param.desc: Whether the target collaboration commission for this creator-product pair is currently effective. `false` means an active campaign collaboration takes precedence.
